acceptance.given: A historical wrapper replay claim is submitted with its recorded wrapper identity and launch evidence available.

oracle.expected: The validator accepts the replay only when execution evidence records that the original wrapper was actually launched, and rejects claims lacking that launch occurrence.
forbidden: Accepting a historical wrapper replay when no original wrapper launch occurred.
Treating indirect, inferred, or merely referenced execution as wrapper-launch evidence.
oracle.observable: A replay-validation result explicitly records wrapper-launch occurrence as a prerequisite and returns rejection for a no-launch historical replay claim.

acceptance.then: Run the historical replay validator against both a launch-backed record and an otherwise equivalent no-launch record; the launch-backed case is accepted and the no-launch case is rejected.
acceptance.when: When validating a historical wrapper replay.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the replay-validation test with historical evidence that omits any original wrapper launch; it must deterministically reject the claim.
Execute the replay-validation test with only indirect or inferred execution indicators and no recorded wrapper launch; it must reject rather than accept the historical replay.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce historical wrapper replay authorization by requiring literal evidence that the original wrapper was launched before accepting the replay claim; indirect or inferred execution cannot satisfy this prerequisite.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing historical replay records and command interfaces; rollback only the launch-occurrence enforcement while retaining append-only evidence and non-authorizing historical semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical replay validation transitions from pending claim to accepted only after original-wrapper launch occurrence is proven; otherwise it transitions to rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A historical wrapper replay claim is accepted iff the validator observes recorded launch occurrence for the original wrapper; any no-launch, indirect, or inferred-only evidence yields rejection.

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages participate in one Toolchain evaluation or rollback workflow.

oracle.expected: The isolation boundary check shows independently controlled mutable state and evidence for every listed component, with no cross-component contamination path.
forbidden: Any listed component shares mutable state with another listed component.
Cross-component mutable-state sharing permits one component to alter another component's execution or result.
oracle.observable: The isolation-boundary inspection and the cross-component substitution witness evaluated during matrix execution.

acceptance.then: Each component operates only on independently controlled mutable state and evidence.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain runs or rolls back the participating components and evaluates the isolation boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject a cross-component mutable evidence substitution and require the isolation check to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Partition mutable state and evidence for Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages, rejecting cross-component evidence substitution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing replay results remain compatible; contamination is rejected rather than represented as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: Shared evaluation workflow with isolation required -> independently owned mutable state and evidence for all participating components.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The boundary check rejects a cross-component state or evidence substitution and finds no mutable-state sharing among the listed components.

acceptance.given: A Stable Package is proposed for a Matrix Case before either subject executes.

oracle.expected: The eligibility record contains verifiable source provenance and an immutable Stable identity bound before execution.
forbidden: A temporary package accepted as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
Stable eligibility without a pre-run immutable identity.
oracle.observable: The Stable eligibility record and pre-execution identity binding evaluated by the SM-6 selector.

acceptance.then: Only a source-qualified Stable subject with its immutable identity pre-bound is eligible for the Matrix Case.
acceptance.when: The SM-6 selector evaluates Stable eligibility before Matrix Case execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or alter the Stable provenance or pre-run immutable identity and require the eligibility selector to reject the subject.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require verifiable source-supported provenance and a pre-run immutable identity before Stable eligibility; reject a temporary differing package as Stable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore Stable eligibility validation without promoting a quality baseline or changing Candidate identity semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Stable provenance eligibility not required -> only pre-run source-qualified immutable Stable subjects are eligible
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Before any Matrix execution, the selector accepts Stable only with verifiable provenance and the immutable identity bound; missing, changed, or temporary-subject identity is rejected.

acceptance.given: A frozen non-empty Consumer Manifest and the reconciled repository real-call surface, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, are available.

oracle.expected: Every applicable Consumer completes enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface; rollback observes the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A manifest entry lacks a reconciled real caller.
Configuration-only switching is accepted as rollback.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer transition call receipts and the bidirectional Consumer Manifest/call-surface reconciliation.

acceptance.then: All applicable transitions for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry are complete.
acceptance.when: The Consumer transition selector executes against the frozen manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer transition selector with one applicable real-call-surface transition omitted or unreachable.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete non-empty Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with the repository real-call surface, then require each applicable Consumer to execute enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real interface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer routes and require rollback to reproduce the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen manifest with applicable transitions pending -> every applicable Consumer has real-call receipts for enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector proves 100% transition completion for the reconciled non-empty manifest and rejects omissions, unreachable consumers, and configuration-only rollback.
